pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to data discrepancies across systems, leaving significant revenue uncollected.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up

pain_points.statement: CFO Rita Donovan is skeptical of consulting engagements after a previous vendor failed to deliver on time in 2023.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.

desired_state.statement: Structure Phase 1 as a fixed-fee engagement with milestone payments within a $250,000 to $400,000 budget range.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Strong preference for fixed-fee with milestone payments over T&M.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) from three weeks back down to the industry standard of approximately five days.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: the secondary metric is days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard, which is about five days.

success_criteria.statement: Achieve productivity gains high enough to avoid hiring additional dispatcher headcount next year.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: that's a real productivity win and it pays for itself in headcount we don't have to hire next year.

risks_unknowns.statement: Phase 1 funding will be reallocated to other projects if a working pilot is not in production by the end of Q3 (September 30).
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Rita — our CFO — agreed to the budget on the condition that we have something measurable in production by end of September. Otherwise the funding gets pulled into other projects.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must manually bridge data between the custom Rails dispatch tool (Routemaster), Salesforce, and the driver mobile app.
pain_points.source_excerpt: So it's three systems for one assignment, and the dispatcher is the integration layer.

pain_points.statement: The driver mobile app is outdated and lacks modern capabilities like photo uploads, issue flagging, and direct messaging.
pain_points.source_excerpt: They can't take photos, they can't flag issues, they can't message the dispatcher.

desired_state.statement: Pursue an incremental technical enhancement strategy for the Routemaster platform rather than a full system overhaul.
desired_state.source_excerpt: He's been pushing for that for a year... make the case for incremental change instead of a full rebuild.
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus Patel wants to execute a complete rebuild of the 7-year-old Rails application, whereas VP of Operations Sarah Chen mandates an incremental change approach to meet Q3 timeline goals.

success_criteria.statement: Automate data reconciliation between Routemaster, Salesforce, and NetSuite to stop manual data mistyping.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce... and finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

risks_unknowns.statement: Federal ELD compliance update in November poses an unknown technical requirement risk if system changes impact compliance tracking.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: There's an ELD compliance deadline in November — federal mandate update... It's not officially in scope for this engagement, but if your approach can avoid creating new compliance work for him, that's a quiet point in your favor.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend 12 minutes per load on repetitive manual data entry across 60 to 90 loads per day.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Right now our average dispatcher takes about twelve minutes to fully process a load through all three systems.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend 2 to 3 hours daily on phone calls with drivers because the mobile app is inadequate.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Every dispatcher tells me they spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers because the app doesn't do what they need.

pain_points.statement: Finance spends full-time manual effort cross-referencing mismatched proof of delivery, rate confirmations, and load numbers.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is doing detective work on every single invoice. They have one person doing it full-time and she's drowning.

desired_state.statement: Address operational pain in priority order: first invoice reconciliation, second dispatcher workflows, and third driver app updates.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Honestly, invoicing is the bleeding wound. We need to fix that first... Second is the dispatcher workflow... Third is the driver app.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce average load processing time per dispatcher from 12 minutes to 8 minutes (a 30% reduction).
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we can get that to eight minutes — call it a thirty percent reduction — that's a real productivity win

risks_unknowns.statement: Incomplete technology and process integration from two 2024 acquisitions may complicate standardization across operational workflows.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

pain_points.statement: Rapid 40% growth through acquisitions has created operational friction and fragmented tech systems across the organization.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Deliver quick win value in Phase 1 to build credibility with executive leadership and justify subsequent engagement phases.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'd rather come in at the lower end and earn the next phase than overpromise.

success_criteria.statement: Win the three-way competitive vendor selection by leveraging relevant experience from the Cascade Freight engagement.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: You're at the top of my list because of the Cascade Freight work, but I owe Rita due diligence.

risks_unknowns.statement: Strategic disagreement between Operations and Technical leadership over project roadmap and architectural vision.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Marcus will want to dig into the technical approach... he has strong opinions about Routemaster because he built half of it.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Operations (Sarah Chen) prioritizes rapid, incremental workflow fixes to resolve immediate cash flow and dispatcher pain by Q3, while CTO Marcus Patel favors a complete, multi-year rebuild of the core dispatch tool.
